Jordan L: Heads-up: Ivy (healthcare) signed LOI for a 2-week Private POC. Blocker: they insist on HSM-backed keys and want ephemeral cert rotation managed by them. Need a clear transfer & bootstrap plan + quick pricing delta vs Dedicated. Can we land this in ~48h?

Amy S: Short answer: yes, two onboarding paths. 1) Full BYOK with HSM-wrapped key transfer (enterprise-preferred). 2) Temporary Redwood-managed key for POC (fast lane). I'll outline tradeoffs and a one-page decision brief.

Carlos M: For BYOK/HSM the minimal artifacts we need from Ivy: (A) HSM wrapping public cert or wrapping key descriptor, (B) PKCS#11-wrapped key blob (base64), (C) HSM attestation statement (vendor/firmware/quote), (D) CA-signed agent cert PEM, (E) VPC/subnet list and egress policy. No code changes on our side.

Leila T: On rotation: during POC we can accept 30-day rotation if they handle it in their HSM. For production we require automated rotation <=7 days or a documented emergency rotation playbook. Also ask for key escrow instructions and who owns escrow.

Jordan L: How do they deliver the wrapped blob securely? I want a non-manual option for scale.

Carlos M: Options: (1) SFTP transfer to a scoped SFTP endpoint we provide (short-lived creds), (2) Customer pushes to a presigned private S3 URL we issue over the control-plane TLS channel, or (3) they publish to an SSH bastion we access. Prefer (2) or (1) for auditability. If HSM, we expect PKCS#11 wrap; we accept base64 of the wrapped blob.

Leila T: Also need the CSR flow: they generate key material in HSM, produce CSR via internal CA, sign agent cert, return PEM chain. We validate the cert chain and verify subject alt names match the provided VPC DNS. Copy-paste CSR guidance below.

Carlos M: CSR guidance (copy-paste):
```
# generate CSR using HSM PKCS#11 provider (example with pkcs11 engine)
# placeholder commands - vendors differ
pkcs11tool --module /usr/lib/your-hsm-pkcs11.so --keypairgen --key-type rsa:3072 --label agent-key
pkcs11tool --module /usr/lib/your-hsm-pkcs11.so --certreq --label agent-key --outfile agent.csr
# then have internal CA sign: ca-client sign agent.csr -> agent.crt
```

Amy S: Minimal onboarding JSON (copy-paste, fill values):
```
{
  "customer":"Ivy Health",
  "env":"private-poc",
  "vpc_id":"vpc-0aa11bb22",
  "subnets":["subnet-1","subnet-2"],
  "key_mode":"HSM",
  "hsm_wrap_cert":"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----...",
  "wrapped_key_blob_b64":"BASE64_WRAP_BLOB",
  "agent_cert_pem":"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----..."
}
```

Leila T: Validation steps we run after they submit artifacts: 1) Verify HSM attestation doc, 2) Fetch wrapped blob from provided location, 3) Attempt local unwrap simulation (we do a KMS-like check using provided wrap cert), 4) Upload agent cert to staging control plane, 5) Bootstrap agent inside their VPC, 6) Run encrypt/decrypt + sign/verify smoke tests.

Jordan L: Pricing question: what's the delta to Dedicated trial? Ivy wants ballpark before committing.

Amy S: Ballpark: Private POC has an onboarding & platform staging fee (one-time ~$5k) + optional engineering support hours and infra egress costs (variable). Dedicated trial is usually cheaper infra-only (~$2k credit for reserved GPUs) but lacks BYOK/HSM. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance and DM them.

Carlos M: Networking note: if they have strict egress, agent supports outbound via HTTP proxy; we need proxy host:port + auth method, or we deploy a small outbound relay image in their VPC which fetches model blobs using presigned URLs. Either way, supply proxy config in the JSON.

Leila T: For audit & security questionnaire reply: we'll state: HSM attestation required, BYOK accepted, audit logs retained for 90 days for POC, rotation cadence (POC 30d, prod <=7d), and Redwood-managed key path requires a custody addendum. I'll prepare the blurb and send to legal.

ops_bot: Ticket created: https://internal.redwood/onboard/1995559999. Checklist items: artifacts, attestation, wrapped-blob retrieval, agent bootstrap, validation run.

Jordan L: Okay — Amy take customer comms + pricing. Carlos prep the validation gist and sample SFTP/S3 steps. Leila loop legal for custody addendum. I'll lock the 48h kickoff once we have the JSON template and SFTP/presigned URL options in hand.

Amy S: Will send the customer-facing checklist + pricing in 30m.

Carlos M: I'll paste the validation script link and SFTP instructions in ~45m.

Leila T: I'll draft the security paragraph for the questionnaire and tag legal.

Jordan L: Thanks team. I'll coordinate the calendar with Ivy.
